candidate_workaround: Permit a current candidate only when its retained failed witness is present; require a passing witness before terminal promotion.
failure_signature: The skill preflight required every method to be terminal while the current recovery method was correctly still a candidate with a failed witness.
recurrence_guard: Candidate state is accepted only for an active recorded failure; it never receives preferred credit before a pass.
rollback: Give the 19-of-20 retry zero portfolio credit and leave the active candidate unpromoted.
scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded Method Flow preflight recovery only; no broader workflow or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Allow retained active candidates without premature promotion
trigger_preconditions: a retry runs while its recovery method is still candidate
a failed witness is already retained
